scope: Completed review 2: complete candidate/source, candidate/src/rev2, legacy host/dependencies/acceptance, C# launcher, bound protocols, and targeted native/D0 evidence. Traced all four review-1 corrections, including cpu8_monitor.py and tool_binding.py. All 952 manifest members matched their recorded hashes and sizes.

findings.title: Delivery verification accepts an incomplete evidence manifest
findings.trigger: Supply a nonempty manifest that omits retained evidence or consumed outer-monitor/tool files while keeping every listed member valid.
findings.effect: The verifier checks only listed members; it never reconciles the manifest against the evidence inventory or consumed inputs. It can report restoration_verified=true and CPU8_INTEGRATION_PASS without authenticating the complete delivered evidence. Omitted failed-attempt diagnostics can disappear without rejection.
findings.recommendation: Require unique canonical members, exact inventory coverage with explicit delivery-tail exclusions, and coverage of consumed inputs. The existing src/rev2/verify.py inventory checks provide the relevant pattern.

findings.title: Unreconciled watchdog receipt can bypass the delivery deadline
findings.trigger: Advance standalone WATCHDOG_RECEIPT.json.end_ns while leaving WATCHDOG_END.receipt and its raw terminal timestamp unchanged.
findings.effect: Neither verify_cpu8.py, cpu8_monitor.py nor tool_binding.py compares the two receipts. wall_budget therefore accepts the altered closure frontier: advancing it two minutes can make an actual 31-minute delivery appear to take 29 minutes and pass the 1,800-second limit.
findings.recommendation: Require equality with WATCHDOG_END.receipt and reconcile its identity, OS-exit fields and closure interval against the raw lifecycle before calculating budgets.

limitations: Read-only static review; no project code, tests, scripts or native libraries executed, no delegation, and no files changed. DLL bytes were hashed only.
Counterexamples are established from source, not executed. Supplied native evidence was inspected selectively.
This verdict does not certify formal eight-case execution, future data-only bindings, restoration, or complete-task OS accounting. Historical approvals remain historical.
